patch_description:
This crossover keeps the strongest parts of the prior programs while emphasizing the main failure mode: regime fragility and prediction collapse. The feature set is rebuilt around shorter lookbacks, rolling z-scores, and “change in market character” signals such as volatility trend, efficiency trend, and regime shifts. I also keep a compact set of interactions like momentum × volatility regime, which often generalize better than raw signals alone.

On the model side, I make XGBoost slightly more expressive than the most over-regularized versions, while still retaining enough constraint to avoid overfitting. The target clipping is loosened a bit to preserve amplitude, and winsorization is applied after feature construction to reduce tail dominance without destroying signal.

The result is a compact, regime-aware feature crossover designed to improve val slope, val correlation, and prediction variance without exceeding the feature budget or using any lookahead.
